---
title: "Ingest SDMs: NOAA SEFSC GoMex Cetacean & Sea-Turtle Densities"
subtitle: "Monthly hexagon abundance (#/40 km²) → density → population-percentile suitability [1,100] on the global 0.05° grid"
msens:
  target_name: ingest_sdm_gm
  workflow_type: ingest
  dependency: [build_cell_grid]
  output: data/manifests/ingest_sdm_gm.json
  dataset: {ds_key: gm, response_type: density, source_authority: NOAA SEFSC, temporal_interval: monthly, native_format: vector,
            description: "NOAA SEFSC Gulf of Mexico cetacean and sea-turtle spatial density models (NCEI 0256800 v2.2), monthly, 40 km2 hexagons. Mapped onto [1,100] by the population-percentile transform (ud), which is scale-free. Species groups (genus / family models, or a model covering several species) are ingested for review (is_guild).",
            value_info: "population percentile of the cell's density within its model (100 = densest cell; val >= 100 - p is the p % core)"}
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

NOAA SEFSC [Gulf-of-Mexico cetacean & sea-turtle spatial density models](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/metadata/landing-page/bin/iso?id=gov.noaa.nodc:256800)
(NCEI 0256800 v2.2) — 19 hexagon shapefiles, one per species/population, each carrying monthly abundance
`{Mon}_n` (individuals per 40 km² hexagon, `-9999` = no data). Like the **nc** seabird ingest
(`ingest_sdm-nc.qmd`), v11 rasterizes each (species × month) onto the global 0.05° cell grid and maps the
heavy-tailed density onto the merge's **[1,100]** scale by the **population-percentile** transform
(`msens::density_to_suit(method = "ud")`), plus an **annual** surface for scoring. Two dolphins are modelled
as split **Oceanic + Shelf** populations; each population is rasterized on its own geometry (the Oceanic
hexagons are clipped, the Shelf ones "Unclipped") and the densities are **summed** per cell.

- **Inputs are local** (`gm_shp_dir` in `libs/paths.R`, `GM_SHP_DIR` overrides): the 19 shapefiles and
  `../spp_gmx.xlsx` under `{dir_raw}/sdm/gm/0256800/2.2/data/0-data/`, hydrated by `scripts/pull_from_laptop.sh --drive`.
- **`mdl_key`**: monthly `gm|{sp_id}|{01..12}` + annual `gm|{sp_id}`; `sp_id = WORMS:{AphiaID}` of `taxa_sci`,
  resolved offline from `spp.duckdb`'s `worms` table (no API call).
- **Density** = `{Mon}_n / 40` individuals km⁻², regridded with `cells_from_raster(digits = NULL, min_value = 1e-12)`.
  The v8 ingest left `digits` at its default 2, which rounded the RAW densities (0.001–0.01 individuals km⁻² for the
  rare species) to 0.00 / 0.01 *before* dividing by the cap: Rice's whale (`gm|WORMS:1576133`) and the beaked-whale
  model (`gm|WORMS:137035`) came out flat 100 over their range.
- **Value transform (v11 Q6, D12).** Per model (species × month) AFTER regridding:
  `val = density_to_suit(d, "ud", area = cell area_km2)` — 100 minus the percent of the modelled population in
  cells strictly denser than this one, so the densest cell is 100 and `val >= 100 - p` is exactly the p % core.
  Cells with `val < 1` are dropped (the merge's floor). The old recipe (`GM_TRANSFORM=cap`: linear to the species'
  pooled p99.5 of positive density, now applied to the *regridded* densities) stays available and is compared below.
- **Annual** = `msens::density_annual(n_intervals = 12)` on the DENSITIES — a month the model does not cover counts
  as zero — and THEN the same transform. The v8 ingest averaged the transformed values over the months a cell was
  *present* in; the Kogia model covers April–November only, so its annual was biased upward by 12/8.
- **Guilds** (`is_guild`): a `sp_id` whose WoRMS rank is not Species (Delphinidae for the blackfish, *Ziphius*
  for all beaked whales, *Globicephala*, *Kogia*), or whose `spp_gmx` row names several species. They keep their
  `gm|WORMS:{id}` keys, so nothing downstream is renamed, and `merge_models_prep.qmd` excludes `is_guild` rows.
- The sea turtles in this dataset are real species and are ingested like any other; the merge gives turtles
  their own rule.

> **Not yet folded into merge/scoring** unless `FOLD_DENSITY` is set (`merge_models_prep.qmd`).

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

librarian::shelf(arrow, DBI, dplyr, duckdb, fs, glue, here, jsonlite, logger, purrr, readr, sf, stringr,
                 terra, tibble, tidyr, xml2, quiet = T)
library(msens)                      # the installed msens (density_to_suit / density_annual); never via shelf(), which can reinstall a stale main
source(here("libs/paths.R"))
source(here("libs/vars.R"))
source(here("libs/duckdb_budget.R"))
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)

ds_key    <- "gm"
dir_atlas <- glue("{dir_big_v}/marine-atlas")
dir_dist  <- glue("{dir_atlas}/dist/dataset={ds_key}"); dir_create(dir_dist)
mdl_csv   <- glue("{dir_atlas}/dist/model_{ds_key}.csv")
manifest  <- here("data/manifests/ingest_sdm_gm.json"); dir_create(path_dir(manifest))
cmp_csv   <- here("data/gm_transform_compare.csv")
cog_base  <- "https://file.marinesensitivity.org/cog/sdm/raw"
p_cap     <- 0.995                     # the density percentile the OLD recipe used as the 100 point
NA_VAL    <- -9999                     # the shapefiles' no-data
shp_dir   <- path.expand(gm_shp_dir)
taxa_xls  <- path.expand(glue("{shp_dir}/../spp_gmx.xlsx"))
stopifnot("gm inputs not found: hydrate raw/sdm/gm (scripts/pull_from_laptop.sh --drive) or set GM_SHP_DIR" =
            dir_exists(shp_dir) && file_exists(taxa_xls), file_exists(cellid_tif))

# flags (this notebook's own; default = the v11 recipe) ----
gm_transform <- tolower(Sys.getenv("GM_TRANSFORM", "ud"))         # ud (v11) | cap (the v8 recipe, for comparison)
stopifnot("GM_TRANSFORM must be 'ud' or 'cap'" = gm_transform %in% c("ud", "cap"))
log_info("gm: transform = {gm_transform}; inputs = {shp_dir}; redo = {redo_ingest}")

if (redo_ingest && dir_exists(dir_dist)) { dir_delete(dir_dist); dir_create(dir_dist) }

r_grid <- rast(cellid_tif)             # global 0.05° template (values = cell_id)

# write one model surface as (mdl_key, cell_id, val) parquet. mm = NA -> annual key/file.
pq_path <- function(safe, mm) if (is.na(mm)) glue("{dir_dist}/{ds_key}_{safe}.parquet") else
                                             glue("{dir_dist}/{ds_key}_{safe}_{mm}.parquet")
write_surface <- function(d, sid, mm, safe) {
  mk <- if (is.na(mm)) glue("{ds_key}|{sid}") else glue("{ds_key}|{sid}|{mm}")
  msens::write_atlas_parquet(                              # V2/zstd/80MB row groups (Phase A)
    tibble(mdl_key = as.character(mk), cell_id = as.integer(d$cell_id), val = d$val),
    pq_path(safe, mm))
}
```

## Cell areas

The `ud` transform weights each cell by its area (the population in a cell is density × area). The
`cell` table is a property of the grid, not of the release: this version's `sdm.duckdb` is used when
`build_cell_grid` has written it, else `ver_prev`'s (which `build_cell_grid` copies unchanged).

```{r}
#| label: cell-area

sdm_cell_db <- c(sdm_db, glue("{dir_big}/{ver_prev}/sdm.duckdb")) |> path_expand() |> keep(file_exists) |> first()
stopifnot("no sdm.duckdb with a cell table (this version's or ver_prev's)" = !is.null(sdm_cell_db))
log_info("cell areas from {sdm_cell_db}")
con_sdm <- dbConnect(duckdb(sdm_cell_db, read_only = TRUE))
duckdb_tune(con_sdm, glue("{dir_big_v}/_tmp/gm"))
ca <- dbGetQuery(con_sdm, "SELECT cell_id, area_km2 FROM cell")
dbDisconnect(con_sdm, shutdown = TRUE)
area_by_id <- rep(NA_real_, 7200 * 3600); area_by_id[ca$cell_id] <- ca$area_km2
# the cell table holds the OCEAN cells only, while the regridded surfaces fade into land cells along the
# coast (whole range, no land mask): those take the area of their latitude row (a cell's area depends on
# its row alone; the table's rows are constant to 1e-9 relative)
row_of <- \(id) (id - 1L) %/% 7200L + 1L
a_row  <- ca |> mutate(row = row_of(cell_id)) |> group_by(row) |>
  summarise(a = first(area_km2), spread = max(area_km2) / min(area_km2) - 1, .groups = "drop")
stopifnot("cell area is not constant within a row" = max(a_row$spread) < 1e-6)
area_by_row <- rep(NA_real_, 3600); area_by_row[a_row$row] <- a_row$a
cell_area <- function(id) {
  a <- area_by_id[id]; miss <- is.na(a)
  if (any(miss)) a[miss] <- area_by_row[row_of(id[miss])]
  stopifnot("a cell id has no area (no ocean cell in its row)" = !anyNA(a), all(a > 0))
  a }
log_info("cell table: {nrow(ca)} ocean cells, area {round(min(ca$area_km2), 3)}-{round(max(ca$area_km2), 1)} km2; ",
         "land cells take their row's area")
rm(ca)
```

## Models + species crosswalk

```{r}
#| label: models

# spp_gmx.xlsx (one sheet, header row 1: taxa_doc, taxa_sci, repeats, taxa_common, taxa_code_auto, taxa_shp).
# A minimal reader (zip + xml2) so the notebook needs no spreadsheet package.
read_xlsx_sheet1 <- function(path) {
  td <- tempfile(); dir_create(td); on.exit(dir_delete(td))
  utils::unzip(path, exdir = td)
  ns <- c(d = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main")
  ss <- read_xml(file.path(td, "xl/sharedStrings.xml")) |> xml_find_all("//d:si", ns) |>
    map_chr(\(x) paste(xml_text(xml_find_all(x, ".//d:t", ns)), collapse = ""))
  cells <- read_xml(file.path(td, "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml")) |> xml_find_all("//d:sheetData/d:row/d:c", ns)
  typ <- xml_attr(cells, "t")
  v   <- map_chr(cells, \(x) { n <- xml_find_first(x, "d:v", ns); if (inherits(n, "xml_missing")) NA_character_ else xml_text(n) })
  is_s <- !is.na(typ) & typ == "s" & !is.na(v)
  v[is_s] <- ss[as.integer(v[is_s]) + 1L]
  ref <- xml_attr(cells, "r")
  d <- tibble(col = sub("[0-9]+$", "", ref), row = as.integer(sub("^[A-Z]+", "", ref)), v = v)
  hdr <- d |> filter(row == 1) |> select(col, name = v)
  d |> filter(row > 1) |> left_join(hdr, by = "col") |> select(row, name, v) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = v) |> select(-row)
}
d_taxa <- read_xlsx_sheet1(taxa_xls)
stopifnot("spp_gmx.xlsx columns changed" = all(c("taxa_doc", "taxa_sci", "taxa_common", "taxa_shp") %in% names(d_taxa)),
          nrow(d_taxa) == 19)

# one row per shapefile; the two split-population dolphins are Oceanic_* / Shelf_*
m <- tibble(path_shp = as.character(dir_ls(shp_dir, glob = "*.shp"))) |>
  mutate(base_shp   = path_ext_remove(path_file(path_shp)),
         taxa_shp   = str_replace(base_shp, "(.*)_Monthly_.*", "\\1"),
         population = if_else(str_detect(base_shp, "^(Oceanic|Shelf)_"),
                              str_replace(base_shp, "^(Oceanic|Shelf)_.*", "\\1"), NA_character_)) |>
  left_join(d_taxa |> select(taxa_shp, taxa_sci, taxa_common, taxa_doc), by = "taxa_shp")
stopifnot("19 shapefiles expected" = nrow(m) == 19, "a shapefile has no spp_gmx row" = !anyNA(m$taxa_sci))
```

`sp_id` = `WORMS:{AphiaID}` of `taxa_sci`, resolved from the `worms` table (accepted, animal, exactly one
hit per name). A WoRMS rank other than *Species*, or a `spp_gmx` description naming several species (inside
the parentheses: a comma, "and", or "sp."/"spp."), makes the `sp_id` a **guild**.

```{r}
#| label: crosswalk

con_spp <- dbConnect(duckdb(path.expand(spp_db), read_only = TRUE))
nm <- unique(m$taxa_sci)
wm <- dbGetQuery(con_spp, glue("
  SELECT scientificName AS taxa_sci, CAST(taxonID AS VARCHAR) AS worms_id, taxonRank AS rank
  FROM worms WHERE taxonomicStatus = 'accepted' AND kingdom = 'Animalia'
    AND scientificName IN ({paste(dbQuoteString(con_spp, nm), collapse = ',')})"))
dbDisconnect(con_spp, shutdown = TRUE)
stopifnot("a taxa_sci has no / several accepted WoRMS animal records" = setequal(wm$taxa_sci, nm), !anyDuplicated(wm$taxa_sci))

# a spp_gmx description that names several species ("Ziphius and Mesoplodon spp.", "Orcinus orca, ... combined", "Globicephala sp.")
names_several <- \(doc) { inner <- str_extract(doc, "\\(([^)]*)\\)", group = 1)
                          !is.na(inner) & str_detect(inner, ",| and |spp?\\.") }
m <- m |> left_join(wm, by = "taxa_sci") |>
  mutate(sp_id           = glue("WORMS:{worms_id}") |> as.character(),
         names_several   = names_several(taxa_doc),
         is_guild        = rank != "Species" | names_several,
         # a split-population model is ONE taxon: drop the Oceanic / Shelf prefix from the common name
         common_name     = str_remove(taxa_common, "^(Oceanic|Shelf) "))

# regression: the ids the v8-v10 ingests produced (via the WoRMS API) are the ones resolved here, and the
# guilds are exactly the four genus / family models
ids_v10 <- c(136980, 137017, 137035, 137098, 137105, 137106, 137107, 137108, 137109, 137111, 137119,
             137205, 137206, 137208, 137209, 1576133, 159024)
ids_v10 <- paste0("WORMS:", ids_v10)
stopifnot("sp_id set differs from v8-v10's 17" = setequal(unique(m$sp_id), ids_v10),
          "guild set changed (expected Delphinidae, Globicephala, Ziphius, Kogia)" =
            setequal(unique(m$sp_id[m$is_guild]), paste0("WORMS:", c(136980, 137017, 137035, 159024))))
stopifnot("one sp_id has several is_guild values" = all(tapply(m$is_guild, m$sp_id, \(x) length(unique(x))) == 1),
          "one sp_id has several common names" = all(tapply(m$common_name, m$sp_id, \(x) length(unique(x))) == 1))
log_info("gm shapefiles: {nrow(m)}; sp_id: {n_distinct(m$sp_id)}; split-population shapefiles: {sum(!is.na(m$population))}; guild sp_id: {n_distinct(m$sp_id[m$is_guild])}")
knitr::kable(m |> distinct(sp_id, taxa_sci, rank, names_several, is_guild) |> arrange(desc(is_guild), sp_id),
             caption = "sp_id by WoRMS rank; a guild is a non-Species rank or a description naming several species")
knitr::kable(m |> count(sp_id, taxa_sci, name = "n_shp") |> filter(n_shp > 1), caption = "sp_id with several shapefiles (populations summed)")
```

## Regrid + transform

```{r}
#| label: functions

# one shapefile (one population) -> long (cell_id, interval, dens) on the 0.05° cells: density = {Mon}_n / 40
# individuals km-2, each month rasterized on a template cropped from the cell-id COG, then cells_from_raster()
# (zero-filled; digits = NULL because the raster holds NATIVE density, which rounds to 0 at 2 decimals; min_value is
# a positive epsilon, i.e. "any positive density"). A month with no modelled hexagon (-9999 everywhere) is absent.
dens_cells_shp <- function(path) {
  x   <- read_sf(path) |> st_transform(4326)
  mos <- intersect(glue("{month.abb}_n"), names(x))
  v   <- terra::vect(x |> select(all_of(mos)))
  tmpl <- terra::crop(r_grid, terra::ext(v), snap = "out")
  map_dfr(mos, \(mo) {
    f  <- as.numeric(v[[mo]][, 1])
    ok <- which(f != NA_VAL & !is.na(f))
    if (!length(ok)) return(NULL)
    vv <- v[ok]; vv$dens <- f[ok] / 40
    r  <- terra::rasterize(vv, tmpl, field = "dens")
    msens::cells_from_raster(r, cellid_tif, min_value = 1e-12, digits = NULL) |> rename(dens = val) |>
      mutate(interval = sprintf("%02d", match(str_remove(mo, "_n$"), month.abb)))
  })
}

# a sp_id's models as (cell_id, interval, dens): populations summed per cell and month
sp_dens <- function(sid) {
  paths <- m$path_shp[m$sp_id == sid]
  map_dfr(paths, dens_cells_shp) |>
    group_by(cell_id, interval) |> summarise(dens = sum(dens), .groups = "drop")
}

# density -> [0,100]: the v11 population percentile (ud, area-weighted by the cell table), or the v8
# recipe (cap: linear to the species' pooled p99.5 of positive density, clamped)
to_val <- function(dens, cell_id, how, cap = NA_real_) {
  if (how == "ud") msens::density_to_suit(dens, "ud", area = cell_area(cell_id), digits = 2)
  else             round(100 * pmin(dens / cap, 1), 2)
}
```

### The annual surface is the mean over ALL twelve months

A month the model does not cover counts as zero. Checked on the densities, before any transform, on
hand-picked species: with twelve months the annual equals the plain mean of the months; the Kogia model covers
April–November only, so its annual is exactly 8/12 of the mean over its modelled months, and lower than the
present-only mean the v8 ingest used (by n_present / 12).

```{r}
#| label: annual-check

wide_of <- \(d) d |> pivot_wider(names_from = interval, values_from = dens, values_fill = 0)

# twelve months: annual == plain mean of the twelve (checked on three species, one of them Rice's whale)
chk12 <- c(`Sperm whale` = "WORMS:137119", `Rice's whale` = "WORMS:1576133", `Loggerhead` = "WORMS:137205")
for (nm_ in names(chk12)) {
  d   <- sp_dens(chk12[[nm_]]); stopifnot(n_distinct(d$interval) == 12)
  ann <- msens::density_annual(d, n_intervals = 12)
  plain <- wide_of(d) |> transmute(cell_id, mean12 = rowMeans(across(-cell_id)))
  j <- inner_join(ann, plain, by = "cell_id")
  stopifnot("annual != plain 12-month mean" = nrow(j) == nrow(ann), nrow(j) == nrow(plain),
            max(abs(j$dens - j$mean12)) < 1e-12 * max(j$mean12))
}

# Kogia, April-November only
kg <- sp_dens("WORMS:159024")
stopifnot("Kogia months changed (expected Apr-Nov)" = setequal(unique(kg$interval), sprintf("%02d", 4:11)))
ann_kg <- msens::density_annual(kg, n_intervals = 12)
w_kg   <- wide_of(kg)
mean_modelled <- w_kg |> transmute(cell_id, m8 = rowMeans(across(-cell_id)))              # mean over the 8 modelled months (zeros counted)
present_only  <- kg |> group_by(cell_id) |> summarise(po = mean(dens), n_ssn = n(), .groups = "drop")   # the v8 recipe's statistic
j <- ann_kg |> inner_join(mean_modelled, by = "cell_id") |> inner_join(present_only, by = "cell_id")
stopifnot("Kogia annual != 8/12 of the mean over its modelled months" =
            nrow(j) == nrow(ann_kg), all(abs(j$dens - j$m8 * 8 / 12) < 1e-12 * max(j$m8)),
          "Kogia annual != present-only mean x n_present/12" = all(abs(j$dens - j$po * j$n_ssn / 12) < 1e-12 * max(j$po)),
          "Kogia annual is not below the present-only mean" = all(j$dens < j$po))
chk_tbl <- tibble(model = "Kogia (Apr-Nov)", months = 8L, cells = nrow(j),
                  mean_annual = mean(j$dens), mean_modelled_months = mean(j$m8), mean_present_only = mean(j$po))
log_info("annual checks passed: {length(chk12)} twelve-month species (annual == plain mean); Kogia (8 months): annual == 8/12 x modelled-month mean")
knitr::kable(chk_tbl |> mutate(across(starts_with("mean"), \(v) signif(v, 3))),
             caption = "Kogia: annual vs the mean over its modelled months and the present-only mean the v8 ingest used (cell means)")
rm(kg, ann_kg, w_kg, mean_modelled, present_only, j)
```

```{r}
#| label: rasterize

# per sp_id: regrid every month (populations summed), add the annual (density_annual on the DENSITIES), transform
# each model on its own cells (both recipes, for the comparison), write the selected one.
# resumable (skip existing parquet) unless REDO_INGEST.
sp_ids   <- sort(unique(m$sp_id))
cmp_rows <- list(); cap_rows <- list()
for (sid in sp_ids) {
  safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", sid)
  if (file_exists(pq_path(safe, NA)) && !redo_ingest) next

  dd <- sp_dens(sid)
  if (!nrow(dd)) { log_warn("no positive density for {sid}"); next }
  # the v8 recipe's 100 point: pooled p99.5 of the species' positive (regridded) densities, all months
  cap <- as.numeric(quantile(dd$dens, p_cap, names = FALSE))
  if (!is.finite(cap) || cap <= 0) cap <- max(dd$dens)
  ann <- msens::density_annual(dd, n_intervals = 12) |> mutate(interval = "annual")
  res <- bind_rows(dd, ann) |> group_by(interval) |>
    group_modify(\(x, k) tibble(cell_id = x$cell_id, dens = x$dens,
                                v_ud = to_val(x$dens, x$cell_id, "ud"), v_cap = to_val(x$dens, x$cell_id, "cap", cap))) |>
    ungroup() |> mutate(val = if (gm_transform == "ud") v_ud else v_cap)

  # per-model comparison of the two recipes (cells written = val >= 1)
  q <- \(v) if (length(v)) quantile(v, c(.1, .5, .9), names = FALSE) else rep(NA_real_, 3)
  cmp_rows[[sid]] <- res |> group_by(interval) |>
    summarise(n_cells = n(), n_ud = sum(v_ud >= 1), n_cap = sum(v_cap >= 1),
              ud_q10 = q(v_ud[v_ud >= 1])[1], ud_q50 = q(v_ud[v_ud >= 1])[2], ud_q90 = q(v_ud[v_ud >= 1])[3],
              cap_q10 = q(v_cap[v_cap >= 1])[1], cap_q50 = q(v_cap[v_cap >= 1])[2], cap_q90 = q(v_cap[v_cap >= 1])[3],
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(sp_id = sid, common_name = m$common_name[m$sp_id == sid][1], .before = 1)
  cap_rows[[sid]] <- tibble(sp_id = sid, dens_cap = cap)

  for (iv in unique(res$interval)) {
    d <- res |> filter(interval == iv, val >= 1)
    if (!nrow(d)) next
    write_surface(d, sid, if (iv == "annual") NA_character_ else iv, safe)
  }
}
log_info("rasterized {length(cmp_rows)} sp_id ({gm_transform})")
```

## Model registry (`model_gm.csv`) + transform comparison

```{r}
#| label: model-csv

# stats of every written surface, read back from the parquet (so a resumed run is complete too)
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
duckdb_tune(con, glue("{dir_big_v}/_tmp/gm"))
surf <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
  SELECT mdl_key, count(*) AS n_cells, round(min(val), 2) AS val_min, round(max(val), 2) AS val_max
  FROM read_parquet('{dir_dist}/*.parquet') GROUP BY mdl_key"))
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

# dens_cap per sp_id: this run's, else the previous registry's (resume)
caps <- bind_rows(cap_rows)
prev_gm <- if (file_exists(mdl_csv)) read_csv(mdl_csv) else tibble()
if ("dens_cap" %in% names(prev_gm))
  caps <- bind_rows(caps, prev_gm |> distinct(sp_id, dens_cap) |> filter(!sp_id %in% caps$sp_id))

meta <- m |> group_by(sp_id) |>
  summarise(common_name = first(common_name), scientific_name = first(taxa_sci), rank = first(rank),
            is_guild = first(is_guild), worms_id = first(worms_id),
            populations = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(population))), collapse = "|"),
            taxa_shp = paste(sort(unique(taxa_shp)), collapse = "|"), .groups = "drop")
# one model row per surface written: the months + the annual
model_gm <- surf |>
  mutate(sp_id = str_extract(mdl_key, "^gm\\|([^|]+)", group = 1),
         interval = coalesce(str_extract(mdl_key, "\\|(\\d\\d)$", group = 1), "annual")) |>
  left_join(meta, by = "sp_id") |>
  left_join(caps, by = "sp_id") |>
  mutate(response_type = "density", transform = gm_transform) |>
  select(mdl_key, interval, sp_id, common_name, scientific_name, rank, is_guild, worms_id, populations,
         response_type, transform, dens_cap, val_min, val_max, n_cells, taxa_shp) |>
  arrange(sp_id, interval)
stopifnot("val outside [1,100]" = all(model_gm$val_min >= 1 & model_gm$val_max <= 100),
          "a model has no dens_cap" = !anyNA(model_gm$dens_cap),
          "a surface has no species row" = !anyNA(model_gm$worms_id),
          "every guild must be ingested" = setequal(model_gm$sp_id[model_gm$is_guild], unique(m$sp_id[m$is_guild])),
          "17 annual surfaces expected" = sum(model_gm$interval == "annual") == 17,
          "every species has exactly one annual surface" = all(table(model_gm$sp_id, model_gm$interval == "annual")[, "TRUE"] == 1))
if (gm_transform == "ud")
  stopifnot("a ud model's densest cell is not 100" = all(model_gm$val_max == 100))
write_csv(model_gm, mdl_csv)
log_info("model_gm.csv: {nrow(model_gm)} mdl_keys ({sum(model_gm$interval=='annual')} annual, {n_distinct(model_gm$sp_id)} sp_id, {n_distinct(model_gm$sp_id[model_gm$is_guild])} guilds)")
knitr::kable(model_gm |> count(interval, name = "n"))
knitr::kable(model_gm |> distinct(sp_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |> count(response_type, rank, is_guild, name = "n_sp_id"),
             caption = "sp_id by response type, WoRMS rank and guild")
knitr::kable(model_gm |> filter(is_guild, interval == "annual") |> select(mdl_key, common_name, scientific_name, rank, n_cells),
             caption = "guilds: ingested as gm|WORMS:{id}, excluded from the merge (is_guild)")

# the two recipes side by side, per model (species × month|annual); persisted so a resumed run keeps
# the rows of the species it skipped
cmp <- bind_rows(cmp_rows)
if (file_exists(cmp_csv)) cmp <- bind_rows(cmp, read_csv(cmp_csv) |> filter(!sp_id %in% cmp$sp_id))
cmp <- cmp |> arrange(sp_id, interval)
write_csv(cmp |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(v) signif(v, 5))), cmp_csv)
```

```{r}
#| label: compare-transforms
#| results: asis

cat(glue("**{nrow(cmp)} models** (species × month, plus the annual). `n_cells` = cells with a positive ",
         "density; `n_ud` / `n_cap` = cells kept (`val >= 1`) under each recipe; the quantiles are over the kept cells. ",
         "The written surface is `{gm_transform}`.\n\n"))
print(knitr::kable(
  cmp |> mutate(kind = if_else(interval == "annual", "annual", "monthly")) |> group_by(kind) |>
    summarise(models = n(), across(c(n_cells, n_ud, n_cap, ud_q10, ud_q50, ud_q90, cap_q10, cap_q50, cap_q90), \(v) round(median(v, na.rm = TRUE), 1)),
              .groups = "drop"),
  caption = "median over models, by kind"))
cat("\n\n<details><summary>every model, both recipes</summary>\n\n")
print(knitr::kable(cmp |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(v) round(v, 1)))))
cat("\n\n</details>\n\n")
```

### The rounding fault: Rice's whale and the beaked whales, `ver_prev` vs this run

The annual surfaces of the two models the v8 ingest left flat at 100, read from `ver_prev`'s `dist/dataset=gm`
and from this run. Rice's whale (`WORMS:1576133`) is the species; `WORMS:137035` (*Ziphius*) is the beaked-whale
model, which includes Cuvier's beaked whale.

```{r}
#| label: rounding-fault

dir_prev <- path.expand(glue("{dir_big}/{ver_prev}/marine-atlas/dist/dataset={ds_key}"))
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
qs  <- \(dir, tag) dbGetQuery(con, glue("
  SELECT '{tag}' AS run, mdl_key, count(*) AS n_cells, round(min(val), 2) AS min, round(quantile_cont(val, 0.1), 2) AS q10,
         round(quantile_cont(val, 0.5), 2) AS q50, round(quantile_cont(val, 0.9), 2) AS q90, round(max(val), 2) AS max,
         round(avg(CASE WHEN val >= 99.999 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 3) AS frac_100
  FROM read_parquet(['{dir}/gm_WORMS_1576133.parquet', '{dir}/gm_WORMS_137035.parquet']) GROUP BY mdl_key"))
fault <- bind_rows(if (dir_exists(dir_prev)) qs(dir_prev, ver_prev), qs(dir_dist, ver)) |> arrange(mdl_key, desc(run))
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
knitr::kable(fault, caption = glue("annual surfaces: {ver_prev} (cap recipe on rounded densities) vs {ver} ({gm_transform})"))
```

## Manifest

```{r}
#| label: manifest

# content-addressed, deterministic manifest (Phase A) — no wall-clock, so an identical re-ingest
# produces byte-identical bytes and does NOT invalidate downstream targets.
h    <- msens::hash_parquet(glue("{dir_dist}/*.parquet"))
smry <- arrow::open_dataset(dir_dist) |>
  summarise(n_rows = n(), n_mdl = n_distinct(mdl_key),
            val_min = round(min(val), 2), val_max = round(max(val), 2)) |> collect()
msens::report_table(smry, caption = glue("gm density model_cell surface (density → population percentile [1,100], {gm_transform})"))

msens::write_manifest(
  manifest, target = "ingest_sdm_gm", content_hash = h,
  stats = list(
    ds_key = ds_key, n_sp_id = n_distinct(model_gm$sp_id), n_mdl = nrow(model_gm),
    n_guild = n_distinct(model_gm$sp_id[model_gm$is_guild]), transform = gm_transform, p_cap = p_cap,
    note = "monthly + annual density -> population percentile [1,100]; annual = mean over 12 months (uncovered = 0) then transformed; Oceanic+Shelf summed per cell; guilds ingested, excluded from the merge; NOT yet folded into merge/scoring unless FOLD_DENSITY"),
  force = msens::force_target("ingest_sdm_gm"))
```

## Compare with AquaMaps

Most of these cetaceans + sea turtles also have an **AquaMaps** model, so the two SDMs can be
contrasted directly. Drag the **swipe** divider left/right: **AquaMaps** (native 0.5° suitability) on
the left vs this **GoMex** surface (0.05°, months averaged to one annual surface) on the right — both
rescaled to 0–100 (spectral). AquaMaps paints broad, coarse suitability across (and beyond) the Gulf;
the SEFSC survey model resolves fine density structure within it. Pick any species that has both
models and drag the round handle on the divider:
